name: acceptodds map
description: The acceptodds paper map of ICLR 2027 as signals: each paper's place on the map, its region and cluster, and a small embedding, copied from acceptodds.com.
author: Benedict Armstrong

signals.title: Place on the map
signals.description: Where the paper sits on the acceptodds map: a UMAP layout of its title, TL;DR, abstract and keywords, with neighbours from a reranker.

signals.title: Region
signals.description: The paper's broad area on the map (Leiden clusters at a coarse resolution), named by its most typical keywords.

signals.title: Cluster
signals.description: The paper's close group on the map (Leiden clusters at a fine resolution), named by its most typical keywords.

signals.title: Small embedding
signals.description: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small of the title, TL;DR, abstract and keywords, cut to 64 dimensions by PCA and scaled to whole numbers: for the nearest papers.
